summary: State Street Corp filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for an SEC-registered offering of fixed-to-floating rate senior notes due 2037. Terms are unfilled in the preliminary filing: fixed rate through 2036, then SOFR plus a spread, with an optional make-whole-style redemption at par in 2036. Concurrently, subsidiary State Street Bank and Trust launched a separate unregistered Section 3(a)(2) offering of floating and fixed rate senior notes due 2028, not cross-conditioned. Joint book-runners include Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Scotiabank and TD Securities. Routine debt capital markets issuance, not a special situation; watch final pricing and spread.
